result.description: Command-line tool (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG/PNG/PDF files; also has a Node.js API.
result.auth_detail: Local CLI/library with no accounts, API keys or auth. Open-source (MIT) and runs on the user's machine.
result.access_detail: Free open-source npm package or Docker image, with no signup. It needs a local Node runtime and headless Chromium (Puppeteer), so a hosted toolkit would have to run it in a sandbox or container.
result.api_notes: No REST or web API. The `mmdc` CLI takes a Mermaid definition file or stdin and writes SVG/PNG/PDF. It also converts Mermaid blocks in Markdown. Options include custom CSS, icon packs and PNG size. The Node API is a single `run(input, output, opts)` function, and the README says it is not covered by semver.
result.blocker: No hosted API. It is a local CLI that needs Node and Chromium, so a toolkit would need a sandboxed runtime to render. Community MCP servers exist, but there is no official one.

evidence.quote: It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.
This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid.
It's possible to call `mermaid-cli` via a Node.JS API.
